readmeMarkdown:
# Codex GPT Bridge (`codex-bridge`)

English | 简体中文

Python 3.10+ · Zero Dependencies · MCP stdio · Windows / macOS / Linux · MIT License

> **Tired of GPT's defensive lecturing, robotic hedging, and refusal-flavored walls of text? Had enough of arguing with GPT just to get a straight answer?** > > Put an MCP bridge in between: let **Gemini**, **Claude**, or whichever main coding agent you already love handle the conversation under the hood. You keep all of GPT's heavy-duty reasoning and code-review horsepower — while your main agent manages the back-and-forth, filters the attitude, and translates every finding back to you in plain human language. **`codex-bridge`** is a lightweight, zero-dependency **MCP server** and **native plugin** (for **Antigravity**, **Claude Code / Claude Desktop**, and **DeepSeek Harness**) that lets your favorite AI coding agent delegate tasks and code reviews to your local **OpenAI Codex CLI** (`codex`). --- ## Table of Contents - [Why Use codex-bridge](#why-use-codex-bridge) - [Available Tools](#available-tools) - [Prerequisites](#prerequisites) - [Installation and Setup](#installation-and-setup) - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Environment Variables](#environment-variables) - [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) - [Running Tests](#running-tests) - [License](#license) --- ## Why Use codex-bridge - **Smart Quota and Reset-Time Routing**: Your main agent can query live 5-hour and 7-day Codex limits (`codex_quota_status`) before delegating, knowing when to go all-in with `gpt-6.2-astra` and when to conserve quota. - **No Client Timeouts on Deep Audits**: Supports asynchronous background execution (`background: true`) for long analyses and large git diff reviews, collecting results cleanly via `codex_job_status`. - **Multi-Turn Context Continuity**: Preserves Codex sessions across follow-up turns so you can review, fix, and re-verify without starting from scratch. - **Multimodal and Config Profiles**: Attach local screenshots to prompts (`images`) or reuse your existing `~/.codex` config profiles (`profile`). - **Zero Dependencies, Cross-Platform**: Built purely on the Python 3.10+ standard library and works out of the box on Windows, macOS, and Linux. ## Available Tools | Tool | What It Does | | :--- | :--- | | `codex_quota_status` | Checks live 5-hour / 7-day Codex quota, reset times, and recommends a model and reasoning effort. | | `codex_list_models` | Lists the GPT models available on your Codex account along with supported reasoning efforts. | | `codex_exec` | Runs non-interactive prompts, audits, or bounded subtasks with configurable sandbox, images, profiles, session resume, and background execution. | | `codex_review` | Runs read-only git code reviews on uncommitted changes, branch diffs, specific commits, or custom focus areas. | | `codex_job_status` | Monitors and collects results from background jobs and lists active resumable sessions. | | `codex_job_cancel` | Cleanly cancels queued or running background jobs and terminates their child processes. | --- ## Prerequisites 1. **OpenAI Codex CLI** installed and signed in: ```bash codex --version codex login status # Should show: Logged in using ChatGPT ``` 2. **Python 3.10+** installed: ```bash python --version ``` --- ## Installation and Setup Choose your client: - [1. Antigravity](#1-antigravity) - [2. Claude Code and Claude Desktop](#2-claude-code-and-claude-desktop) - [3. DeepSeek Harness](#3-deepseek-harness) - [4. Cursor, Windsurf, WorkBuddy and Other MCP Clients](#4-cursor-windsurf-workbuddy-and-other-mcp-clients) --- ### 1. Antigravity Installs the MCP server, `codex-delegate` skill, always-on rule, and `codex_worker` subagent as one bundle (shared across the Antigravity CLI and App). - **Install via Antigravity CLI (`agy`, Recommended)**: ```bash git clone https://github.com/longpi233/codex-bridge.git agy plugin install ./codex-bridge ``` - **Or clone directly into Antigravity's plugins folder**: - **macOS / Linux**: ```bash git clone https://github.com/longpi233/codex-bridge.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-bridge ``` - **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/longpi233/codex-bridge.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" ``` - **Windows (`cmd`)**: ```cmd git clone https://github.com/longpi233/codex-bridge.git "%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" ``` - **Or register an existing clone** in `~/.gemini/config/plugins.json`: ```json { "entries": [{ "path": "/path/to/parent-folder", "include_only": ["codex-bridge"] }] } ``` --- ### 2. Claude Code and Claude Desktop The native plugin bundles all 6 MCP tools, the `codex-delegate` skill, and a native `codex-worker` subagent *(on Claude Desktop, plugin-local MCP servers and subagents apply to **Cowork** and **Claude Code**; if you use the standard Desktop **Chat** tab, use [Manual Setup](#manual-setup-custom-python-path-or-environment-variables) below)*. #### Option A: Sync via GitHub Marketplace (Recommended — Easy Updates) - **Claude Desktop (Cowork)**: 1. Open **Customize** → **Plugins** → **Discover** → click **`+`** *(hovering over `+` shows **Add marketplace**)*. 2. Enter `longpi233/codex-bridge` and click **Sync**. 3. Install **`codex-bridge`** from the synced marketplace. - **Claude Code**: ```text # Claude Code 2.1.275+ /plugin install codex-bridge --marketplace longpi233/codex-bridge # Earlier versions with /plugin /plugin marketplace add longpi233/codex-bridge /plugin install codex-bridge@codex-bridge /reload-plugins ``` You can also load a local clone directly with `claude --plugin-dir /path/to/codex-bridge`. #### Option B: Upload Prebuilt `.plugin` Package (Claude Desktop Cowork) 1. Download **`codex-bridge.plugin`** from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/longpi233/codex-bridge/releases/latest) *(or build it locally with `python scripts/pack_claude_plugin.py`)*. 2. Open **Customize** → **Plugins** → **Upload local plugin** and select `codex-bridge.plugin`. #### Manual Setup (Desktop Chat Tab, Custom Python Path, or Env Vars) - **Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork)**: Open **Settings… → Developer → Edit Config** (`%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json` on Windows or `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` on macOS), use the JSON template in [§4](#4-cursor-windsurf-workbuddy-and-other-mcp-clients) with your Python path (`python` on Windows or `python3` / full path on macOS/Linux), then fully quit and relaunch Claude Desktop. - **Claude Code CLI**: ```bash git clone https://github.com/longpi233/codex-bridge.git /path/to/codex-bridge # Use `python3` instead of `python` on macOS/Linux if `python` is unavailable claude mcp add-json codex-bridge '{"command":"python","args":["-u","/path/to/codex-bridge/server/codex_mcp_server.py"]}' ``` *(Add `-s user` before `codex-bridge` to register globally.)* --- ### 3. DeepSeek Harness DSH supports `codex-bridge` as a native Cordis plugin bundle, automatically mounting all 6 MCP tools and the bundled `codex-delegate` skill (no manual skill copying required). - **Install via DSH CLI (Recommended)**: ```bash # Replace `desktop` with your profile name if different (e.g. `web` or `tui`) dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:longpi233/codex-bridge ``` *(Or pass a local clone path: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/codex-bridge`.)* Then enable **`codex-bridge`** in DSH's Plugins page (or add `"codex-bridge"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles//package.json`). *(If you previously added a manual `cordis.patch.yml` entry below, remove it before enabling the plugin bundle.)* - **Or configure manually via `cordis.patch.yml`**: Append the entry below to `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml` and save (DSH hot-reloads without restarting): ```yaml - insert: - id: codex-bridge-mcp-manual name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: codex-bridge transport: stdio command: 'C:\Python311\python.exe' # absolute path to Python args: ['-u', 'D:\tools\codex-bridge\server\codex_mcp_server.py'] cwd: 'D:\tools\codex-bridge' toolCallTimeoutMs: 1800000 failOnStartupError: true ``` --- ### 4. Cursor, Windsurf, WorkBuddy and Other MCP Clients 1. **Clone the repository**: ```bash git clone https://github.com/longpi233/codex-bridge.git /path/to/codex-bridge ``` 2. **Add `codex_bridge` to your client's MCP configuration** (`~/.cursor/mcp.json`, `%USERPROFILE%\.workbuddy\mcp.json`, Windsurf `mcp_config.json`, etc.): ```json { "mcpServers": { "codex_bridge": { "command": "/path/to/python", "args": ["-u", "/path/to/codex-bridge/server/codex_mcp_server.py"] } } } ``` - Replace `"/path/to/python"` with your Python executable path (e.g. `C:/Python311/python.exe` on Windows or `/usr/local/bin/python3` on macOS/Linux). - **WorkBuddy**: After saving `mcp.json`, completely quit and restart WorkBuddy, then open **Connectors → Custom Connectors** and click **Trust** on `codex_bridge`. 3. **Install the Skill & Rule (Recommended)**: - **Skill**: Copy or symlink `skills/codex-delegate/` to your client's skill folder (`~/.agents/skills/codex-delegate`, `.cursor/skills/codex-delegate`, `~/.workbuddy/skills/codex-delegate`, or `.codebuddy/skills/codex-delegate`). - **Rule**: Copy [`rules/AGENTS.md`](./rules/AGENTS.md) into your project's `AGENTS.md` or client rules directory. --- ## Quick Start Once installed, try asking your main agent: - *"Check my Codex quota and reset time, and recommend which GPT model and reasoning effort we should use."* - *"Ask Codex (`gpt-6.2-astra`) in read-only background mode to review my uncommitted changes for bugs and edge cases."* - *"Send this UI screenshot to Codex via `codex_exec` and check layout alignment against `src/App.tsx`."* --- ## Environment Variables All environment variables are optional: | Variable | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `CODEX_BIN` | Explicit path to `codex` / `codex.exe` if not on `PATH`. | | `CODEX_HOME` | Custom Codex auth/state directory (defaults to `~/.codex`). | | `CODEX_DEFAULT_MODEL` | Fallback model id when `model` and `profile` are omitted. | | `CODEX_BRIDGE_PYTHON` | Explicit Python path for the native DSH plugin bundle. | | `CODEX_BRIDGE_LOG_FILE` | File path to enable optional JSONL diagnostic logging. | | `CODEX_BRIDGE_INCLUDE_EMAIL` | Set to `1` to include unmasked `account.email` in quota status (masked by default). | --- ## Troubleshooting If tools do not show up in your client, verify that the server itself responds cleanly: - **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell $p = @' {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}} {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"} {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"} '@ $p | python -u server/codex_mcp_server.py ``` - **macOS / Linux**: ```bash printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}}' \ '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}' \ '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' \ | python3 -u server/codex_mcp_server.py ``` - **Prints 2 JSON lines listing all 6 tools**: The server is working — check your client's config path, specify the full path to Python, and fully restart the client (in WorkBuddy, also click **Trust** under Custom Connectors). - **Hangs with no output**: Make sure `-u` is included in `args` so Python does not buffer stdout. --- ## Running Tests ```bash # Offline test suite (zero model quota) python tests/test_codex_bridge.py # Live smoke tests using your local Codex CLI python tests/test_codex_bridge.py --live ``` --- ## License Licensed under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).

## What's Changed in v0.2.4

### Security & Runtime Hardening (`codex_mcp_server.py`)
- **Read-only Git Fingerprinting**: Disabled repo-configured `core.fsmonitor`, hooks, and external diff/textconv helpers during `codex_review` fingerprinting, and expanded `workspaceChangedDuringReview` detection to cover staged diffs and untracked file contents.
- **Windows Batch & Process-Tree Safety**: Bypassed Windows `.cmd` wrappers via `node` + `codex.js` when native `codex.exe` is unavailable, blocked shell metacharacters on `.cmd`/`.bat` invocations, and added a `taskkill /F /T` fallback when Job Object assignment is unavailable.
- **Session & Concurrency Integrity**: Pinned newly created persistent session locks from `thread.started` until Turn 1 completes, re-validated `cwd`/sandbox bindings inside the lock on resume (blocking TOCTOU downgrades), required explicit `cwd` for writable sandboxes, rejected leading-dash/control-char CLI tokens, and prevented `SESSION_RUN_LOCKS` leaks on failed/ephemeral resumes.
- **Job Lifecycle & Schema Enforcement**: Made terminal job states immutable against late `codex_job_cancel` calls, verified `request_id` payload fingerprints on reuse, enforced runtime `additionalProperties: false` argument checks, and tightened JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope + MCP `2025-03-26` batch handling.
- **Quota & Model Pagination Fixes**: Normalized missing/empty/expired fallback quota windows safely (`tier: "unknown"`), excluded expired fallback windows from burn recommendations, derived sample age from event timestamps, and flagged truncated/repeated-cursor `codex_list_models` responses.

### Packaging, DSH Bundle & Documentation
- **DSH (`cordis.patch.yml` & `package.json`)**: Restricted `CODEX_BRIDGE_PYTHON` and `CODEX_BIN` overrides to trusted `process`/`user-env` layers, verified Python `3.10+` across Windows (`python`/`python3`/`py -3`) and POSIX `PATH`, validated a single verified `codex-bridge` package root, and included `rules/AGENTS.md` in the npm bundle.
- **Claude `.plugin` Archive**: Updated `scripts/pack_claude_plugin.py` with atomic writes and suffix validation, removing the duplicate `assets/logo.png` copy (9 files total, ~99.7 KB smaller).
- **Docs & Logo**: Added full-resolution transparent logo (`assets/logo-full.png`) for READMEs, clarified Claude Desktop Cowork vs. Chat installation paths, updated DSH manual migration ID (`codex-bridge-mcp-manual`), and aligned skill/agent instructions on cancel-and-resume (`codex_exec` resumable jobs only), polling ranges, and plugin tool naming.

---

## v0.2.4 更新说明

### 服务端安全与并发稳定性加固
- **只读审查指纹加固**：`codex_review` 指纹计算禁用仓库自定义 `core.fsmonitor`、Hooks 与外部 diff/textconv 程序，并补齐对暂存区（`diff --cached`）与未跟踪文件内容的变更检测。
- **Windows 子进程与进程树兜底**：未找到原生 `codex.exe` 时优先通过 `node` + `codex.js` 直接启动以绕过 `cmd.exe`，拦截 `.cmd`/`.bat` 参数中的 shell 元字符；Win32 Job Object 不可用时降级使用 `taskkill /F /T` 清理进程树。
- **会话与后台任务安全**：新建持久化会话自 `thread.started` 起即持有互斥锁直至首轮完成；`resume` 获取锁后二次校验 `cwd` 与沙箱等级；可写沙箱强制要求显式 `cwd`；严格校验 `request_id` 请求指纹、终态不可逆、CLI Token 防注入与 `additionalProperties: false`。
- **协议与配额边界修复**：补齐 JSON-RPC 2.0 信封校验与 MCP `2025-03-26` 批处理支持；空/缺失/过期回退配额窗口不再误判为可用配额或触发消耗建议，并修正 `codex_list_models` 重复游标检测。

### 多平台打包与文档完善
- **DSH 插件加固**：隔离项目 `.env` 对 Python/Codex 路径的覆盖，实测校验 Python `3.10+` 与单一受信任包根目录，并在 npm 包内补齐 `rules/AGENTS.md`。
- **Claude `.plugin` 精简**：移除与 `.claude-plugin/icon.png` 重复的 `assets/logo.png`（缩减至 9 个文件），并采用原子写入。
- **文档与视觉资源**：README 启用高清透明背景徽标 `assets/logo-full.png`，明确 Claude Desktop Cowork 与 Chat 的差异及各端轮询/续接说明。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/longpi233/codex-bridge/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4
